additionalDefectsFound: The price-list browser harness selected an obsolete history row during refetch; it now waits for the actual new table price before selecting rollback, without sleep, reload or forced clicks.

Kyrgyz numeric formatting differed between server ICU and Chrome, causing hydration errors in new client previews. Preview values are now formatted on the server and passed as strings; no hydration-warning suppression was used.

The existing local image-provider key returned HTTP 401. The ignored local configuration was restored from the already configured, successfully validated Bazaar image-provider credential without logging its value.
dataSafety: No customer records were reset, seeded or used in automated tests. Production diagnostics were read-only aggregates. Real AI checks used only a synthetic bottle image and an isolated local output directory. No schema changes were introduced.
releaseAcceptance: After publication, verify CI for the exact pushed SHA, the actual canonical production alias, public route smoke and private DB/migration/Redis health. Release evidence is recorded separately to avoid a self-referential CI commit.
